stories.h: Doris Ogala remanded in Lagos ahead of bail hearing as Sowore condemns detention
stories.p: Nollywood actress and Abia governorship candidate Doris Ogala has been remanded in a Lagos correctional centre after being arraigned over a complaint filed by Pastor Chris Okafor. Her bail application is due to be heard on Friday. Activist Omoyele Sowore has described the remand as an abuse of state power.
body: Nollywood actress Doris Ogala, who is the African Action Congress (AAC) candidate for governor of Abia State in 2027, has been remanded in a correctional centre in Lagos after appearing in court on Wednesday, 28 October 2026. Her application for bail is listed for hearing on Friday, 30 October.
## What happened

Ogala was arraigned before a Federal High Court in Lagos on three counts linked to a complaint by the cleric Pastor Chris Okafor. The charges relate to the alleged publication of photographs, the alleged spreading of false electronic messages and alleged threats against the pastor. She has not been convicted of anything, and the allegations are yet to be tested at trial.

News of the remand first spread on Wednesday afternoon, when comedian Deeone shared it online. Reports differ on which Lagos facility she was taken to. Before she was led away, Ogala posted a short video from the courtroom in which she described the case as a political move aimed at stopping her governorship bid. Clips of the moment she was taken out of court were shared widely on Thursday.
## Background

The dispute between Ogala and Okafor has played out on social media for months. It reportedly began after the pastor announced plans to marry another woman, which led Ogala to criticise him publicly. She has since spoken several times about their past relationship. In another video from court, she was also heard telling the judge that her former partner was using the law against her.
## How people reacted

Human rights activist and politician Omoyele Sowore condemned the remand in a Facebook post, calling it an abuse of power. He accused the police of repeatedly using the Cybercrimes Act to shield powerful people, argued that what he called a private quarrel should not have become a criminal case, and urged the courts to stay impartial. He also said her rights as a candidate must be protected. Online, fans were divided, with some backing the actress and others saying she should answer the charges in court.
## What happens next
All eyes are now on Friday's bail hearing in Lagos. Her party has not yet said how the case will affect her campaign in Abia.
more: Ogala faces three counts linked to a complaint by Pastor Chris Okafor; she denies wrongdoing and calls the case political.
Her bail application is due to be heard on Friday, 30 October.
Sowore says police are misusing the Cybercrimes Act.

stories.h: Tinubu leaves for Umrah in Makkah as Atiku and Sowore question the trip
stories.p: President Bola Tinubu departed Abuja on Thursday for Saudi Arabia to perform Umrah and pray for Nigeria, the Presidency says. Atiku Abubakar's campaign has demanded proof of his daily activities there, while a presidential aide dismissed Omoyele Sowore's claim that the trip is for medical treatment.
body: President Bola Tinubu left Abuja on Thursday, 29 October 2026, for Makkah in Saudi Arabia, where the Presidency says he will perform Umrah, the lesser Islamic pilgrimage. The trip has quickly become the latest flashpoint in the race for the 2027 presidential election.
## What the Presidency said

Announcing the journey, the President's adviser on information and strategy, Bayo Onanuga, said the visit was for spiritual reflection and prayers for Nigeria's peace, unity and progress. Before leaving, Tinubu was scheduled to commission new equipment for the Nigerian Air Force at the Presidential Wing of the Abuja airport. No return date was announced.
## Atiku's demands

In a statement issued on Wednesday by Phrank Shaibu, communications director of the ADC presidential campaign, Atiku Abubakar claimed to have information that the President's real destination after a brief stop in Makkah was France. He asked the Presidency to publish daily proof of Tinubu's presence at the holy sites, to say whether the trip was linked to his health, to release the full itinerary and to explain how the journey was being paid for. The statement also raised questions about a reported loan request. Atiku said he would join other Nigerians in praying for the country but insisted the questions be answered.
## Sowore's claim and the reply

Activist Omoyele Sowore also claimed the President was travelling for medical care. Responding on X on Thursday, Tinubu's aide on social media, Olusegun Dada, rejected the claim. He pointed to the President's recent schedule, including the flag-off of his re-election campaign in Kaduna, meetings at the State House and a Federal Executive Council meeting, and said a sick man could not keep such a programme. Dada added that Tinubu made similar trips before the APC primary and the general election in 2022.
## What happens next
The opposition is expected to keep pressing for details while the President is away, and the Presidency has not said when he will return to Abuja.
more: The Presidency says the trip is for prayer and spiritual reflection.
Atiku's camp claims France is the real destination; the Presidency has not addressed that claim directly.
An aide says Tinubu is in good health and made similar trips in 2022.

stories.h: State police moves closer as 30 state assemblies reportedly back constitution change
stories.p: Thirty state Houses of Assembly have now approved the constitutional amendment that would allow states to set up their own police, according to Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila. That is well above the 24 needed, and the bill now goes back to the National Assembly before it can be sent to President Tinubu for assent.
body: The plan to allow Nigerian states to run their own police forces has crossed a major hurdle. Femi Gbajabiamila, Chief of Staff to the President and chairman of the Presidential Working Group on the reform, said 30 state Houses of Assembly have now endorsed the constitutional amendment, comfortably above the 24 required.
## What happened

Gbajabiamila gave the update at the Nigerian Economic Summit in Abuja. He said 24 assemblies had approved the proposal by 23 October, and six more have since joined. Lagos, Niger, Kogi and Ebonyi were among the latest to vote in favour. A full list of the 30 states has not been published.
## What happens next

The National Assembly must now collect the state resolutions and send the amendment bill to President Bola Tinubu for his signature. Separately, a draft National Policing Bill and 29 related amendment bills were sent to the Ministry of Justice on 19 October for review. After that review they will go to the President and then to the National Assembly.
## The money question

Gbajabiamila stressed that states wanting their own police must show they can pay for it over time, including salaries, training and maintenance, and not just vehicles and equipment. States that are not ready will continue to rely on federal policing. He asked business groups to suggest ways of supporting funding, but warned that private donations must never buy influence over an investigation. Responding to fears that governors could misuse state police against opponents, he said a citizen's right to protection must not depend on who they support or where they come from.
## Background

Calls for state police have grown for years amid kidnapping, banditry and communal attacks in many parts of the country. Senate President Godswill Akpabio also defended the reform this week. Earlier in October, only a handful of assemblies had voted, which made the recent rush of approvals a surprise to many observers.
more: Thirty assemblies have reportedly approved; 24 were needed.
The bill now returns to the National Assembly before going to Tinubu.
States must show they can fund their own police over the long term.

stories.h: Spain mourns as death toll in Toledo high-speed train crash reportedly rises to 69
stories.p: Spain has begun three days of national mourning after a high-speed train reportedly crashed into a stationary train near Urda in Toledo province on Wednesday. The regional leader of Castilla-La Mancha says 69 people have died, and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has promised an investigation.
body: Spain began three days of national mourning on Thursday, 29 October 2026, after a high-speed train reportedly ran into the back of a stationary train near the town of Urda in the central province of Toledo on Wednesday. The regional leader of Castilla-La Mancha, Emiliano García-Page, said the death toll had risen to 69 after another body was found overnight.
## What happened

According to reports, the moving train struck the stationary one from behind, and three carriages came off the tracks. On Thursday morning, rescue teams with sniffer dogs were still searching the wreckage, while cranes lifted carriages and police officers and soldiers combed the site. The number of people injured has not been confirmed in the reports seen so far, and the cause of the collision has not been announced.
## What the government said

Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez visited the scene and promised a full investigation as well as safety improvements on the railways. He reportedly said Spain must strengthen train safety to win back public trust in high-speed rail, and said it was unacceptable for the country to suffer two high-speed accidents in a single year.
## Background

The crash is Spain's second deadly high-speed rail disaster of 2026. In January, a train derailed near Adamuz in Andalusia and collided with a train coming the other way, killing dozens of people the first deadly accident on a Spanish high-speed train since the network opened in 1992. Spain has one of the largest high-speed rail systems in the world, and both disasters have raised hard questions about maintenance and signalling.
## What happens next

Investigators are expected to examine the signalling and the movements of both trains in the hours before the crash. Further updates on the victims and the injured are expected as families are informed.
more: The regional leader says 69 people have died; the cause has not been announced.
Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has promised an investigation and safety improvements.
It is Spain's second deadly high-speed rail crash of 2026.

stories.h: Obi says election riggers will go to jail under him as Keyamo mocks his Nasarawa remarks
stories.p: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi told a town hall in Nasarawa State that INEC officials and others who rig elections will be jailed if he becomes president. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo has hit back on X, ridiculing comments Obi made in a radio interview about keeping public funds in banks.
body: Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), has said anyone who rigs elections under his government will go to prison. He made the comments at a party town hall in Nasarawa State on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, during a campaign visit that has also drawn a sharp response from the ruling party.
## What Obi said

Asked what his party would do about rigging in 2027, Obi said that under his presidency INEC officials or anyone else who manipulated elections would be jailed. He said strengthening political parties and the electoral process would make rigging impossible, and that the law would apply equally to everyone, from the President to the ordinary citizen. He also proposed that candidates for public office should prove they attended primary and secondary school, with records open to public checks, and said anyone found to have forged certificates would face prison.
## Keyamo's reaction

In a radio interview during the same visit, Obi argued that Nigeria would be much richer if public money had been kept in banks earning interest instead of being mismanaged. He also said the results of government projects should speak for themselves without ceremonies or television coverage. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo seized on those comments in a post on X on Thursday, describing them in strongly mocking terms and saying he did not know whether to laugh or cry. He claimed the remarks explained what he described as a fall in Obi's popularity.
## Background

Obi, a former Anambra governor, came third in the 2023 presidential election as the Labour Party candidate and is now running on the NDC ticket with Rabiu Kwankwaso as his running mate. Exchanges between his camp and senior APC figures have grown more heated since campaigns began this month, with both sides trading personal attacks online.
## What happens next
Obi is expected to continue his tour of the North Central, while the APC campaign has indicated it will keep challenging his record in office.
more: Obi says INEC officials who rig elections will be jailed if he wins.
He wants candidates' school records to be open to public checks.
Keyamo mocked his comments about keeping public money in banks.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan takes a swipe at Blord over power station business as Kokopee speaks on his rift with Davido
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has mocked businessman Blord, saying critics who doubted his container power station venture are now upset by it. Separately, his friend Kokopee says VDM felt betrayed by Davido and that he tried privately to save their friendship.
body: Social media activist Martins Vincent Otse, better known as VeryDarkMan (VDM), is again at the centre of online debate, this time over his new power station business and his broken friendship with Davido.
## The swipe at Blord

In a video shared on Thursday, 29 October 2026, VDM boasted about the container power stations he has been importing from China under his Ratel brand. He said people first claimed the project would never work but were now asking how he managed it, adding that his critics had been complaining since he unveiled the container. He aimed the comments at businessman Blord, claiming he was the first to talk about the idea and that Blord rushed into a similar venture afterwards. Blord had not publicly responded at the time of writing. VDM also said each buyer would be limited to two units, and that he would not sell in bulk.
## Kokopee on the Davido rift

Separately, content creator Kokopee, a close friend of VDM, said in an Instagram video on Wednesday that he acted as a go-between when the relationship between VDM and Davido began to fall apart. He said VDM felt let down by the singer and that a sense of betrayal was at the heart of the quarrel, while Davido disagreed with VDM's view of events. Kokopee declined to share the private details of their conversations and said his support for VDM had always been private advice rather than public backing. He also promised to speak later on a separate matter involving the rapper Zlatan.
## How people reacted

Reactions online were mixed. Some fans praised VDM for turning to business, while others questioned whether he could sustain it. On the Davido rift, many fans urged both men to settle their differences, while others shared unproven theories about what caused the split.
## Background

VDM and Davido were once seen as allies, but their friendship cooled publicly earlier this year. The activist has spent recent weeks promoting the Ratel power stations, which he showed off at a warehouse and in demonstration videos.
more: VDM says critics have been 'crying' since he unveiled his power station containers.
He says buyers will be limited to two units each.

stories.h: Cars damaged as suspected thugs reportedly attack APC rally in Katsina
stories.p: Suspected thugs reportedly stormed an APC campaign rally in Malumfashi, Katsina State, on Wednesday, smashing car windows and leaving several people with minor injuries. The police had not commented at the time of the report.
body: An All Progressives Congress (APC) campaign rally in Malumfashi Local Government Area of Katsina State was reportedly disrupted on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, when a group of suspected thugs attacked party members and their vehicles.
## What happened

According to reports, APC supporters had gathered to campaign for the party's candidates ahead of the 2027 general elections when the attackers arrived. They were said to be chanting a Hausa phrase meaning 'we do not agree' as they threw stones and other objects at the crowd. Several cars were damaged, with windscreens and windows smashed, and the attack reportedly caused panic among motorists and passengers in the area. Several people are said to have suffered minor injuries, although no exact number has been given.
## Official response

The Katsina State Police Command had not commented on the incident at the time of the report, and no arrests have been announced. The APC has also not issued a public statement on who it believes was responsible.
## Background

Katsina, the home state of the late former President Muhammadu Buhari, is an APC stronghold, but the 2027 contest in the North West is expected to be keenly fought, with the ADC, NDC and other parties also campaigning hard for votes. Campaigns for the 2027 elections formally began this month, and security agencies have repeatedly warned parties against using thugs. Similar clashes at rallies have been reported in other states in recent weeks.
## What happens next
Observers are calling on the police to investigate and on all parties to restrain their supporters as campaigning intensifies across the North.
more: Attackers reportedly chanted 'we do not agree' as they threw stones.
Several people were said to have minor injuries.
Police had not commented at the time of the report.

stories.h: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany discharged from hospital after collapse
stories.p: Vincent Kompany has left hospital after collapsing at Bayern Munich's training ground. The club says he suffered meningeal irritation and will rest and take medication, with no date set for his return to the touchline.
body: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany was discharged from hospital on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, days after he collapsed at the club's training ground. The club said he will now rest at home before returning to work.
## What happened

Kompany collapsed on Friday while watching a second-team training session. Bayern later said the cause was meningeal irritation, an inflammation of the membranes around the brain. Earlier that week he had skipped media duties before the Champions League match against Arsenal because of a viral infection, although he was in the dugout for the 2-2 draw.
## What the club said

Sporting director Max Eberl described the discharge as the best possible news for everyone at the club. He said Kompany would rest and take medication and expressed confidence that the coach would return at full strength. Assistant coach Aaron Danks confirmed that Kompany would only return after receiving medical clearance and said there was no fixed timescale. In his absence, the coaching staff led the team to a 6-1 win over Magdeburg in the German Cup.
## Background

Kompany, a former Manchester City captain and Belgium international, took charge of Bayern in 2024 after spells as manager of Anderlecht and Burnley. He led the club back to the Bundesliga title in his first season and remains popular with players and fans.
## How fans reacted

Messages of support poured in from around football after news of the collapse broke, with former teammates and rival clubs wishing him a full recovery. Fans welcomed the update on Wednesday but urged the club not to rush him back.
more: The club says the cause was meningeal irritation.
There is no fixed date for his return.
Bayern beat Magdeburg 6-1 without him.

stories.h: Abdul Samad Rabiu praises ex-wife Hannatu Musawa after surprise visit to his Abuja office
stories.p: BUA Group founder Abdul Samad Rabiu has shared photos from a surprise visit by his former wife, Culture Minister Hannatu Musawa, to his office in Abuja. He said their friendship and respect have lasted over the years, and many fans praised the friendly tone.
body: Billionaire industrialist Abdul Samad Rabiu, founder of BUA Group, has drawn a wave of warm reactions online after he shared photos of an unannounced visit by his former wife, Hannatu Musawa, to his office in Abuja.
## What happened

In an Instagram post on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, Rabiu described the visit as a pleasant surprise. He referred to Musawa as someone he once called his wife and said times change but friendship and mutual respect remain. He also praised her work in developing Nigeria's culture and creative sector.
## Who is Hannatu Musawa

Musawa is Nigeria's Minister of Art, Culture and the Creative Economy and a member of President Bola Tinubu's cabinet. A lawyer and politician, she has been in charge of the ministry since 2023. She and Rabiu were married in the past and later separated.
## How people reacted

The post drew thousands of reactions within hours. Many users praised the former couple for showing that people can part ways and still respect each other, with one describing it as the healthiest divorce they had seen. Others joked that the pair should remarry, while some simply welcomed a rare moment of good news on their timelines.
## Background

Rabiu is one of Africa's richest people, with interests in cement, sugar, flour and real estate through BUA Group. He was named among the continent's wealthiest people again this year and is known for keeping his private life largely out of the public eye, which made the post all the more talked about.
more: Rabiu called Musawa someone he 'once called my wife'.
Musawa is the Minister of Art, Culture and the Creative Economy.
Fans praised the friendly tone of the post.

stories.h: Reps threaten arrest warrants for MTN, Airtel and Glo bosses over poor network
stories.p: A House of Representatives committee investigating poor telecom services says the heads of MTN, Airtel, Globacom and other operators must appear in person by 4 November or face arrest warrants. Lawmakers rejected a request for an industry body to speak on their behalf.
body: The House of Representatives has threatened to issue arrest warrants against the chief executives of Nigeria's major telecom companies if they fail to appear before a committee investigating poor network services.
## What happened

The ad hoc committee, chaired by Olumide Osoba of Ogun State, invited MTN Nigeria, Airtel Nigeria, Globacom, Mafab Communications and other licensed operators to explain persistent dropped calls, slow internet, failed airtime and data purchases, and poor coverage in many communities. When the companies again failed to send their top executives, lawmakers adjourned the hearing to 4 November 2026 and insisted the chief executives appear in person.
## What lawmakers said

Lawmaker Sunday Umeha said the committee had considered seeking arrests at an earlier sitting but decided to give the executives another chance. He noted that invitations had been sent directly to the CEOs through the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC), and a representative of the regulator confirmed this at the hearing. The committee also rejected a request for the chairman of the Association of Licensed Telecommunications Operators of Nigeria (ALTON), Gbenga Adebayo, to speak for the companies. Umeha's motion requiring each CEO to appear was adopted by voice vote.
## Background

Complaints about network quality have grown since telecom tariffs went up last year, with many subscribers saying they now pay more for worse service. Operators have blamed vandalism of fibre cables, power supply problems and the high cost of running sites.
## What happens next
If the CEOs do not appear on 4 November, the committee says it will seek warrants to compel their attendance.
more: CEOs must appear in person on 4 November.

stories.h: FEC approves East and West super grids to lift power transmission to 19,000MW
stories.p: The Federal Executive Council has approved procurement for new East and West super grids, which the Minister of Power says should raise transmission capacity from about 5,000MW to 19,000MW within two years. Tinubu has also ordered the clearing of more than 300 containers of power equipment stuck at the ports.
body: The Federal Government has approved the start of procurement for two new high-capacity power lines, known as the East and West super grids, in a bid to fix the weak transmission network that stops much of Nigeria's electricity from reaching homes and businesses.
## What happened

The decision was taken at the Federal Executive Council meeting chaired by President Bola Tinubu in Abuja on Wednesday, 28 October 2026. Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe told State House correspondents that the goal is to raise transmission capacity from about 5,000MW to 19,000MW within two years. He said Nigeria already has more than 13,000MW of available generation, but much of it is stranded because the grid cannot carry it.
## The routes

The corridors are planned to run from Sokoto through Abuja into parts of the South. The government will start with the Lagos–Ogun, Benin–Port Harcourt and Abuja–Kaduna–Kano corridors. Tegbe said Lagos and Ogun alone account for about half of national electricity demand. The council also approved new transformers for the Ikeja West substation, a new line at the Katampe substation in Abuja and the upgrade of the Itumola–Shagamu line. The cost of the projects was not disclosed.
## Other measures

Tegbe said a four-week technical audit is under way to make sure money goes to projects with real impact. The government has paid ₦1.23 trillion of about ₦3.3 trillion owed to gas suppliers and other power-sector players. Tinubu also ordered the ports and customs to clear more than 300 containers of electricity equipment, some of which have been stuck for up to 20 years. Work has started on a new National Control Centre in Osogbo to replace a facility that is 64 years old.
## What happens next
Nigerians, used to frequent grid collapses, will be watching for results. The minister said the Lagos and Ikeja projects would show quickly whether power reaches consumers.
more: The target is 19,000MW of transmission capacity in two years.
More than 300 containers of power equipment are to be cleared from the ports.
The cost of the super grids was not disclosed.

stories.h: Cooking gas now sells for up to ₦1,600 per kg as demand rises
stories.p: Cooking gas prices range from about ₦1,200 to ₦1,600 per kg across Nigeria, with Bauchi the most expensive, according to regulator data. Daily consumption rose to 5.2 kilotonnes in September, ahead of supply, and stocks cover only about 16 days.
body: Nigerian households are paying between about ₦1,200 and ₦1,600 for a kilogramme of cooking gas, according to the latest data from the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority (NMDPRA) for September 2026.
## The prices

The regulator's survey found the highest price in Bauchi, at ₦1,600 per kg, and the lowest in Abuja, at about ₦1,200. In Lagos, prices ranged from ₦1,250 to ₦1,400. That means refilling a 12.5kg cylinder now costs roughly ₦15,000 to ₦20,000 depending on location.
## Demand and supply

Daily consumption of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) rose by about 8 per cent to 5.2 kilotonnes in September, well above the official benchmark of 3.9 kilotonnes. Supply also rose, to about 4.7 kilotonnes a day, but still fell short of consumption by roughly 500 tonnes daily. Local production now provides almost all the gas, with NLNG and Seplat supplying more than half, while imports fell sharply. The Dangote Refinery supplied about 15 per cent. Stocks were enough for about 16 days, against a required 30, although the regulator said the figures did not point to a nationwide shortage.
## Background

Gas prices rose by up to ₦75 per kg in two days earlier this month as international crude prices climbed, with some suppliers raising their rates from around ₦1,175 to ₦1,250 per kg. More families have switched to gas from kerosene and charcoal in recent years, pushing up demand.
## What it means

For many families already under pressure from food and transport costs, the price of a refill has become another monthly worry. The regulator says the rise in local supply has helped shield buyers from sharper swings in world prices.
more: Bauchi has the highest price at ₦1,600/kg; Abuja the lowest.
A 12.5kg refill costs about ₦15,000–₦20,000.

stories.h: Kwankwaso joins TikTok as NDC launches its 2027 campaign council
stories.p: NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso has announced that he is now on TikTok, promising verified information, live updates and glimpses of his daily life. The move came on the same day the party inaugurated its presidential campaign council.
body: Former Kano State governor Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, running mate to Peter Obi on the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) ticket, has joined TikTok as the 2027 campaign moves further onto social media.
## What happened

Kwankwaso announced his arrival on the video platform in a post on his official X account on Wednesday, 28 October 2026. He said he would use TikTok to share verified information, live updates and exclusive content from his daily life, and closed the post with his campaign line that Nigeria will be okay.
## Why it matters

TikTok has become one of the busiest spaces for political debate among young Nigerians, with supporters of all the major candidates producing videos, skits and live sessions every day. Several politicians have opened accounts in recent months to speak directly to younger voters. The NDC is expected to rely heavily on young people, who formed a large part of Obi's support base in 2023, while Kwankwaso's Kwankwasiyya movement has a strong following in the North.
## Background

The announcement came on the same day the NDC inaugurated its presidential campaign council for the January 2027 elections. Kwankwaso, who was the NNPP presidential candidate in 2023, has teamed up with Obi on a joint ticket. The APC, ADC and other parties have also stepped up their online campaigns since the official start of campaigning.
## How people reacted
Supporters quickly shared the account, while some critics joked that politicians only discover new apps during election season.
more: Kwankwaso says he will share verified information and live updates.
The NDC inaugurated its campaign council the same day.
Young voters are a key target for all the major parties.

stories.h: Tompolo's PBAT movement presents 30 campaign vehicles in Owerri as Uzodimma backs Tinubu
stories.p: The PBAT Door-to-Door Movement, led by Government Ekpemupolo (Tompolo), has launched its Imo chapter in Owerri with 30 campaign vehicles, 30 generators and 60 speakers. Governor Hope Uzodimma pledged to work with the group for President Tinubu's re-election.
body: A pro-Tinubu campaign group led by former Niger Delta militant leader Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, has expanded into Imo State with a large show of campaign materials.
## What happened

The PBAT Door-to-Door Movement inaugurated its Imo chapter on Tuesday, 27 October 2026, at the Ndubuisi Kalu Square in Owerri. The group presented 30 campaign vehicles, 30 generators, 60 public-address speakers and other materials for its work in the state. Tompolo was represented by Kestin Pondi, managing director of Tantita Security Services, the pipeline surveillance company linked to him.
## What was said

Speaking for Tompolo, Pondi backed President Bola Tinubu's re-election and described the government's economic reforms as important for long-term development. Governor Hope Uzodimma praised the initiative and promised to work with the movement, saying the campaign should go directly to communities and explain government policies to residents across Imo's 27 local government areas. The administrator of the Presidential Amnesty Programme, Dennis Otuaro, and the movement's national coordinator, Sunday Asuku, were also present, along with APC leaders.
## Background

The movement has been rolling out chapters across the country ahead of the January 2027 elections. The Owerri event came at a busy time for Uzodimma, who is also involved in a court fight over the APC's Imo West senatorial ticket and has rejected the Rainbow Coalition in the state.
## Why it matters
The South East has been difficult ground for the APC in recent presidential elections, and the party is investing heavily to improve its showing there in 2027.
more: The group presented 30 vehicles, 30 generators and 60 speakers.
Uzodimma promised to take the campaign to all 27 LGAs.
The movement is setting up chapters nationwide.

stories.h: Kenneth Okonkwo apologises to God over Tinubu presidency in TV interview
stories.p: Actor and politician Kenneth Okonkwo has again criticised President Bola Tinubu's government, saying in a television interview that he did not know what Nigerians had done to deserve his presidency. Clips of the comment were widely shared online.
body: Nollywood actor turned politician Kenneth Okonkwo has once again attacked President Bola Tinubu's administration, this time with a remark that quickly went viral.
## What he said

Speaking on News Central TV on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, Okonkwo said he did not know what Nigerians had done to God for Tinubu to become president, and followed it with an apology to God on behalf of the country. A clip of the moment was shared widely on Instagram and X on Wednesday evening.
## Background

Okonkwo, best known for his role in the 1992 classic Living in Bondage, is a lawyer and one of Nollywood's most politically active stars. He supported Tinubu's APC before switching to back Peter Obi and the Labour Party in 2023, when he served as a spokesman for Obi's campaign. He has frequently criticised the government's economic policies, including the removal of the fuel subsidy and the rising cost of living.
## How people reacted

Reactions were sharply divided along political lines. Opposition supporters shared the clip as a summary of their frustration with the economy, while APC supporters reminded him of his past support for the ruling party and accused him of changing sides. The APC has not formally responded to his comments.
## Why it matters
With campaigns for the January 2027 elections now in full swing, celebrities on all sides are becoming more vocal, and their comments are being used by both camps to rally supporters online.
more: Okonkwo made the remark on News Central TV.

stories.h: Davido and Chioma star together in romantic 'Already Falling' music video
stories.p: Davido has released the music video for 'Already Falling', starring his wife Chioma. The couple appear in matching period outfits and later cruise in a red convertible, and fans have praised their chemistry.
body: Afrobeats star Davido has released the music video for his song 'Already Falling', and the star of the show is his wife, Chioma Adeleke.
## What happened

The singer shared the video on Instagram on Wednesday, 28 October 2026, with a short caption presenting it as a gift from the couple to their fans. The video opens with a large portrait of the pair, with Davido performing in front of it. Chioma, a chef and businesswoman known to fans as Chef Chi, then appears in a Victorian-style gown, with Davido in a matching outfit. In one scene she playfully strokes his beard. Later the mood changes as she drives a red convertible while he sings beside her.
## How fans reacted

Fans flooded the comments with praise for the couple's chemistry, describing them as genuine and clearly in love. Many complimented Chioma's look and called the pair Nigerian music royalty, while others said the video showed that the couple did not need to try hard to stand out.
## Background

Davido and Chioma, who married in a lavish ceremony in Lagos in 2024 and have twins, rarely appear together in his videos, which made this release all the more talked about. Davido has been in the news in recent weeks, including over the cooling of his friendship with activist VeryDarkMan.
## What happens next
The video is already among the most-discussed Nigerian music releases of the week, and fans are hoping for more joint appearances from the couple.

stories.h: Uzor Arukwe opens up on being sacked from telecom job before acting fame
stories.p: Actor Uzor Arukwe has revealed that he was dismissed from Etisalat in 2018 after members of the sales team he led sold free promotional data and kept the money. He says someone used his login and that his exit shocked the company.
body: Popular Nollywood actor Uzor Arukwe has shared the story of how he lost his job at a telecom company before he became one of the industry's most in-demand stars.
## What he said

Speaking on the CreativiTea podcast on Thursday, 29 October 2026, Arukwe said he worked in sales at Etisalat, where he led a tech sales team. During a campaign that gave customers free promotional data with MiFi routers, members of his team allegedly charged customers for the data and kept the money. Arukwe said he was not involved, but his login was traced to some of the transactions. He said someone else had been using his login, insisting that was the truth.
## How it ended

As head of the team, he said he was held responsible and was dismissed in 2018, along with one other colleague. He said the decision shook the company because he was well regarded and seen as someone with a future there. He added that he kept the sacking from his parents and dealt with it privately.
## From sales to the screen

Arukwe went on to build a successful acting career and is now one of the most familiar faces in Nollywood films and series. In another part of the interview he also spoke about producers repeatedly offering him the same type of character and said he wants more varied roles.
## How people reacted
Fans praised his honesty, with many saying the story showed that losing a job can sometimes open a new door.
more: Arukwe says someone else used his login.
He kept the sacking from his parents.
He also spoke about being offered the same type of role repeatedly.

stories.h: FIFA reportedly made $5bn from 2026 World Cup tickets and hospitality
stories.p: FIFA reportedly earned about $5 billion from tickets and hospitality at the 2026 World Cup in North America, roughly five times the figure from Qatar 2022. Fan groups have called the prices extortionate, and FIFA says it will publish official figures after its audit.
body: FIFA reportedly earned about $5 billion from ticket sales and hospitality at the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, far more than its original estimate and around five times what it made in Qatar four years ago.
## The figures

According to a report in a British newspaper, the $5 billion figure compares with an earlier FIFA estimate of $3.3 billion for the same revenue stream. Total revenue from the tournament is put at about $15 billion. Qatar 2022 reportedly brought in $929 million from tickets and hospitality. The 2026 tournament had 40 more matches because of the expanded 48-team format, but much of the increase is said to come from higher prices and dynamic pricing, where ticket costs rise with demand. FIFA's resale platform also reportedly takes a 30 per cent cut of resold tickets.
## Criticism

Fan groups have described the prices as extortionate and scandalous. Football Supporters Europe called them a monumental betrayal of fans, many of whom also faced high travel and hotel costs in North America.
## FIFA's response

FIFA has not officially confirmed the $5 billion figure. A spokesperson said more than 100,000 of the 6.81 million tickets were sold at $60, including more than 1,000 for the final. The spokesperson said the money would be reinvested in football, including support for its 211 member associations, and that official revenue figures would appear in its annual report after audits. FIFA also plans to raise funding for member associations to $6.35 billion for 2027 to 2030.
## Why it matters
The figures are likely to add to debate over the cost of attending major tournaments, with fan groups already pressing for price caps at future World Cups.
more: Qatar 2022 reportedly made $929m from the same stream.

stories.h: Omoni Oboli and husband Nnamdi celebrate 26 years of marriage
stories.p: Nollywood actress and filmmaker Omoni Oboli has marked 26 years of marriage to her husband, Nnamdi, calling him the wind beneath her wings. He shared a throwback photo and thanked God for their years together.
body: Nollywood actress, director and producer Omoni Oboli and her husband, Nnamdi Oboli, are celebrating 26 years of marriage.
## What they shared

On Thursday, 29 October 2026, Nnamdi posted a throwback photo of the couple and thanked God for another year together, describing their marriage as the Lord's doing and writing that love lives in their home. Omoni responded with her own tribute, calling him the wind beneath her wings and promising to love him always and forever.
## Background

Omoni Oboli is one of Nollywood's best-known filmmakers. She rose to fame as an actress in the 1990s and has since directed and produced hit films including 'Wives on Strike' and 'Okafor's Law'. She has often spoken about her husband's support for her career and about the importance of family. The couple have three sons.
## How fans reacted
Fans and colleagues congratulated the couple, with many describing them as an example of a lasting marriage in the entertainment industry.
more: Nnamdi shared a throwback photo of the couple.

stories.h: 37 years old, 14 children, 12 different fathers, and still searching for true love!
stories.p: A 37-year-old woman has sparked heated reactions online after reportedly revealing on a talk show that she has 14 children with 12 different men and is still looking for a man who will truly love her. Some have criticised her choices, while others say her past should not stop her finding happiness.
body: A 37-year-old woman has sparked heated reactions on social media after reportedly revealing that she has 14 children with 12 different men and is still searching for a man who will genuinely love her.
Her revelation has left many internet users stunned, with people questioning how she managed to have such a large family at her age while still hoping to find a lasting romantic relationship.

While some people have criticised her past relationship choices, others believe that having children with different partners should not automatically disqualify a woman from finding happiness and companionship.
But there is another side to this conversation.

At 37, with 14 children depending on her, finding a serious partner may come with challenges. Any man considering a relationship with her would have to understand that he is entering a family with enormous responsibilities.
Beyond the jokes and criticism, the bigger questions are about the children's welfare, financial stability, parenting responsibilities and the role of their fathers.
Nevertheless, the woman reportedly remains hopeful that the right man will eventually come into her life.
Now, a sincere question for the men: if you met a beautiful, hardworking and caring woman who has 14 children with 12 different fathers, would you consider marrying her?
Ladies, if this woman were your sister, what advice would you give her?

stories.h: VeryDarkMan sets an example for Nigerian entrepreneurs with public demonstration of Ratel products
stories.p: Instead of relying on adverts and celebrity endorsements, VeryDarkMan has publicly tested his Ratel power stations so buyers can see what they actually do. It is an approach more Nigerian businesses could learn from, though the real test will be how the products hold up after purchase.
body: VeryDarkMan (VDM) deserves recognition for taking a bold approach to marketing his Ratel-branded products, particularly his newly introduced power stations.
At a time when many businesses rely heavily on advertisements, celebrity endorsements and social media publicity to attract customers, VDM has chosen to demonstrate what his products can actually do.

Rather than simply telling Nigerians how powerful and reliable his gadgets are, he has taken the initiative to publicly test their capabilities, showing potential buyers how they work and what they can expect from them.
This is a commendable business approach that other Nigerian entrepreneurs should consider adopting.

One of the biggest challenges facing consumers in Nigeria today is the difficulty of telling quality products apart from those that fail to meet expectations. Many people have spent their hard-earned money on gadgets that promised excellent performance but delivered disappointment.

That is why public product demonstrations matter. By putting his Ratel power stations to the test in front of his audience, VeryDarkMan is giving prospective customers a chance to assess their performance before buying.
Of course, a demonstration alone does not guarantee long-term durability or reliability. However, it provides a useful starting point for customers who want evidence beyond advertising claims.
There is also an important business lesson here: a company that is confident in its products should be willing to show customers what those products can do.

VDM appears to understand that building a successful brand requires more than having thousands of followers or generating excitement on social media. Customers must have reasons to trust what they are buying.

His approach could also encourage healthy competition among Nigerian businesses, particularly those selling electronic gadgets, power solutions and other consumer products. If more entrepreneurs publicly demonstrated their products under realistic conditions, buyers would be better equipped to compare options and make informed decisions.

VeryDarkMan may be known mainly for his social media activism and outspoken personality, but his latest business activities show another side of him as an entrepreneur seeking a place in Nigeria's competitive consumer market.
Whether you support VDM or disagree with his activities, one thing deserves acknowledgement: his willingness to demonstrate his products publicly is a positive example of consumer-focused marketing.
The real test will be whether the products continue to meet customers' expectations after purchase. For now, credit should be given where it is due.
Big kudos to VeryDarkMan! Nigerian entrepreneurs can learn something from this approach.
What do you think? Should companies be required to demonstrate the actual performance of their products before selling them to the public?
stories.alt: VeryDarkMan in a hard hat and hi-vis vest holds a Ratel power station beside a TV, standing fan, laptop and fridge set up for a test

stories.h: VeryDarkMan puts his Ratel Power Station to the test, shows off battery power as Blord rivalry continues
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has demonstrated his newly imported Ratel Power Station, with the smallest 1,200W model running a TV, standing fan and fridge for 5 hours 17 minutes in his test. The demonstration has added fuel to his online rivalry with Blord, whose own gadgets his supporters want to see put through the same test.
body: Popular Nigerian social media activist and businessman Martins Vincent Otse, better known as VeryDarkMan (VDM), has once again got Nigerians talking after demonstrating the capabilities of his newly imported Ratel Power Station.
VeryDarkMan, who recently received a 40-foot container loaded with power stations and other gadgets from China, has begun testing the products to show potential customers what they can do.
One particular demonstration has caught the attention of many people.

In the test, the smallest model, rated at 1,200 watts, powered a television, a standing fan and a refrigerator for 5 hours 17 minutes. The TV drew 74W, the fan 50W and the fridge 150W, a total of 274W when all three were running.
And remember, this is just the smallest model in the range!

For a country like Nigeria, where unreliable electricity continues to affect homes, students, artisans and small businesses, a portable power station with such capabilities could be a useful alternative during power outages.
VDM has previously explained that his target customers include students, barbers, makeup artists and other Nigerians whose daily activities depend on electricity.
However, the demonstration has also added another chapter to the ongoing social media rivalry between VeryDarkMan and businessman Blord.

While Blord has continued promoting his own gadgets through videos and online publicity, supporters of VeryDarkMan are challenging him to demonstrate the actual performance of his products in a similar way.
And this is where the argument becomes interesting. Making promotional videos is one thing, but showing customers what a product can actually do is another.
VDM appears determined to let the performance of his products speak for itself, and his supporters are already celebrating his approach.

The box shows a battery capacity of 932Wh. A runtime of 5 hours 17 minutes fits with that, because a fridge's compressor switches on and off rather than running all the time, so the average load stays below the full 274W. Actual runtime will still vary with the appliances used and how they are used.
Nevertheless, the excitement surrounding the Ratel Power Station shows how much attention VeryDarkMan's latest business venture is attracting.
From activism and philanthropy to importing products from China, VDM is gradually expanding into commercial ventures. And as his supporters would say, VeryDarkMan is whoever he says he is!
Now, the big question is this: between VeryDarkMan's Ratel Power Station and Blord's gadgets, who is actually giving Nigerians better value for their money?
Let the products do the talking!

stories.h: BREAKING: Court sacks Uzodimma as APC senatorial candidate for Imo West, orders INEC to recognise Okorocha
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has ruled that Governor Hope Uzodimma did not win the APC primary for the Imo West Senate seat and that former governor Rochas Okorocha polled the most votes. The court ordered INEC to publish Okorocha as the party's candidate and barred Uzodimma from presenting himself as the candidate.
body: The political battle in Imo State has taken a dramatic turn after a Federal High Court in Abuja ruled that Governor Hope Uzodimma is not the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate for the Imo West senatorial seat.

In a judgment delivered on Thursday, Justice Obiora Egwuatu held that Uzodimma did not win the party's May 18 primary for Imo West and that former governor Rochas Okorocha polled the highest votes. The court ordered INEC to recognise Okorocha and publish his name as the APC's candidate, and barred Uzodimma from presenting himself as the party's candidate.

Okorocha filed the suit in August, arguing that INEC's own monitors' reports showed him as the winner of the primary. His camp says he scored 150,780 votes to Uzodimma's 102,158, while the party's returning officer had declared Uzodimma the winner with 230,464 votes. Uzodimma and the APC had asked the court to throw out the case as filed too late.
It is not yet known whether Uzodimma or the APC will appeal.

The ruling raises fresh questions about the balance of power within Imo APC. It comes amid growing political tension involving Governor Uzodimma and FCT Minister Nyesom Wike over cross-party alliances and control of party structures ahead of the 2027 elections. However, there is no evidence that Wike had anything to do with the court's decision.
Is Hope Uzodimma gradually losing his grip on Imo politics, or is this just a temporary setback in the battle for 2027?

stories.h: VeryDarkMan inspects warehouse of his 40ft container of power banks from China, targets students, barbers and makeup artists
stories.p: VeryDarkMan has shown off the warehouse holding his 40-foot container of power banks and portable power stations from China, saying they are aimed at students, barbers, makeup artists and small businesses hit by Nigeria's power cuts. How affordable they turn out to be will decide how many of those customers they reach.
body: Popular Nigerian social media activist and philanthropist Martins Vincent Otse, widely known as VeryDarkMan (VDM), has once again attracted public attention after visiting his warehouse to inspect a shipment of power banks and portable power stations imported from China in a 40-foot container.

During the visit, VDM explained that the products were brought into Nigeria with students, barbers, makeup artists and other small business owners in mind, particularly those who struggle daily with Nigeria's unreliable electricity supply.
According to him, many Nigerians are unable to study comfortably or run their businesses efficiently because of constant power outages.
For students, having a reliable source of electricity can make a difference when preparing for examinations, attending online classes or studying at night.
For barbers and makeup artists, electricity is equally important. Many depend on electrical equipment to earn their daily income, and every hour without power can mean losing customers and money.
VDM believes that making portable power solutions available to these groups could help reduce some of the difficulties they face.
## From social media activism to business

Over the years, VeryDarkMan has built a reputation for speaking out on issues affecting ordinary Nigerians, particularly people who struggle to make ends meet. His latest business venture appears to reflect that same interest in the challenges facing low-income earners.
Rather than concentrating only on luxury products, VDM says he wants to provide practical solutions that students, artisans and small business owners can use in their everyday lives.
However, the prices, capacities and affordability of the imported products will ultimately determine how accessible they are to the people he hopes to serve.
## A business idea that addresses a real Nigerian problem

Nigeria's electricity challenges have continued to place enormous pressure on households and small businesses. Many artisans spend a significant portion of their earnings on fuel, generator maintenance and alternative power sources just to stay in business.
If VDM can offer reliable portable power stations at affordable prices, the venture could become a useful option for people who cannot afford expensive solar installations or large generators.

What makes this development particularly interesting is his stated intention to combine business with solutions to everyday problems. VDM has made it clear that he intends to make money from the venture while providing products that could make life easier for Nigerians.

VDM continues to show an interest in the struggles of ordinary Nigerians, whether through his activism, humanitarian activities or business ventures. His latest move deserves attention, especially if the products eventually reach students and low-income workers at prices they can genuinely afford.
What do you think about VDM's latest business venture? Would you buy an affordable portable power station to support your studies or business?

stories.h: Uzodimma vs Wike? Imo governor rejects Rainbow Coalition, threatens to take back vehicles from APC members who work against the party
stories.p: Imo Governor Hope Uzodimma has reportedly declared there will be "no Rainbow Coalition in Imo State", warning APC members that he will take back vehicles donated by Tompolo from anyone who works outside the party. The remarks are being read as a message to Nyesom Wike's cross-party allies ahead of 2027.
body: Political tension appears to be brewing in Imo State as Governor Hope Uzodimma sends a strong warning to members of the All Progressives Congress (APC), declaring that there is no room for a Rainbow Coalition in the state.
In remarks attributed to the governor, Uzodimma warned APC members against working outside the party's political structure, insisting that loyalty to the APC must remain their priority.

The governor reportedly went further by threatening to withdraw vehicles donated by Niger Delta leader High Chief Government Ekpemupolo, popularly known as Tompolo, from beneficiaries found supporting political arrangements outside the APC.
"No Rainbow Coalition in Imo State. If I see you work outside the APC party, I'll take the vehicles from you," Uzodimma was quoted as saying.
The governor also expressed appreciation to Tompolo for his generosity and pledged his support whenever the Niger Delta leader needed assistance in Imo State.
"I am very grateful to High Chief Tompolo. Anytime you need us in Imo State, let us know and we'll be there for you," he reportedly added.
## Is Uzodimma drawing a political battle line against Wike?

The governor's reported declaration has raised questions about the political influence of the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, whose name has become associated with cross-party political alliances.

Wike, although a member of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), serves in President Bola Tinubu's APC-led administration and has maintained political relationships across party lines. His political approach has often involved cooperation between politicians belonging to different parties, particularly in Rivers State.
However, Uzodimma's reported warning suggests that he is unwilling to accommodate a similar arrangement within the Imo APC.
Although the remarks could be interpreted as a message to Wike's political allies, they do not, on their own, establish that the two politicians are in a direct confrontation.
## Questions over Tompolo's donated vehicles
Another interesting aspect of the governor's reported statement is his warning about withdrawing vehicles donated by Tompolo.

The remarks raise questions about whether the vehicles were intended as unconditional gifts or whether their continued use is tied to political loyalty. It also remains unclear what authority would govern the withdrawal of the vehicles from beneficiaries.
## What does this mean for Imo politics?

With political calculations already taking shape ahead of the 2027 general elections, Uzodimma's reported position could signal an attempt to strengthen party discipline and prevent competing political alliances from gaining influence within the state.
For now, the bigger question is whether the governor's declaration is simply an internal warning to APC members or the beginning of a wider struggle over political influence.
One thing is certain: if these remarks are accurately reported, Governor Hope Uzodimma has made his position clear. He expects APC members in Imo State to remain loyal to the party.

But should vehicles donated to politicians be withdrawn simply because the beneficiaries choose to support a different political alliance? And could this be the beginning of a political disagreement between Uzodimma and Wike ahead of 2027?

stories.h: No permanent enemies, only permanent interests! Hilda Dokubo reportedly visits Wike, with Kingsley Chinda present
stories.p: Nollywood veteran and activist Hilda Dokubo, long seen as a strong critic of FCT Minister Nyesom Wike, has reportedly visited him at his Port Harcourt home, with Wike ally Kingsley Chinda also present. Nobody outside the meeting knows what was discussed, but it has raised questions about a possible reconciliation or new alliance ahead of 2027.
body: Nigerian politics will teach you lessons that no university can offer!

Nollywood veteran and political activist Hilda Dokubo, who has previously been associated with strong opposition to FCT Minister Nyesom Wike, has reportedly visited him at his Port Harcourt residence.

This is the same Hilda Dokubo whom critics have accused of making hostile remarks about Wike and of supporting groups that displayed his obituary on a coffin during political protests. Those allegations remain unverified.
Now, reports of a meeting between the two have raised eyebrows, especially because of the presence of Kingsley Chinda, a prominent Rivers politician widely regarded as a Wike ally.
The big question is: what could these three political figures be discussing behind closed doors?
Is this political reconciliation? A fresh alliance ahead of the 2027 elections? Or another example of the famous Nigerian political principle, "scratch my back, and I will scratch yours"?

Of course, nobody outside that meeting can say for certain what was discussed. But considering the bitter political disagreements that have characterised Rivers State politics, the reported gathering is bound to generate questions.
It is a reminder for Nigerians to be careful about fighting, insulting and destroying relationships because of politicians.
Today, two politicians are sworn enemies. Tomorrow, they are sitting in the same living room, smiling, shaking hands and possibly negotiating their next political move.
Meanwhile, their supporters are still fighting yesterday's battles on Facebook!

Never gamble your peace, friendships or future on the political quarrels of Nigerian politicians and their celebrity supporters. In Nigerian politics, today's enemy can become tomorrow's political partner.
What do you think brought Hilda Dokubo, Wike and Kingsley Chinda together? Reconciliation, political calculation or something else?

stories.h: Emotional moment boy collapses after his mother surprises him at school following four years abroad
stories.p: A young boy reportedly collapsed with emotion when his mother, who had been living abroad for four years, turned up unannounced at his school. The video of their reunion has touched many online and sparked a conversation about the price families pay when parents travel abroad for a better future.
body: An emotional reunion between a mother and her son has captured attention on social media after the young boy reportedly collapsed upon seeing his mother for the first time in four years.
According to the story accompanying the circulating video, the woman had been living abroad for four years, leaving her son behind while she pursued a better future for her family.
After years of separation, she decided to return home and surprise her son at his school without telling him she was coming.
What was supposed to be a joyful reunion quickly became an overwhelming moment for the young boy.
Upon seeing his mother unexpectedly, the boy reportedly became so overwhelmed that he collapsed, leaving those around him concerned.

The touching scene has sparked emotional reactions online, with many social media users reflecting on the sacrifices parents make when they travel abroad in search of better opportunities for their children.

For many families, living abroad comes with a painful price. Parents sometimes spend years away from their children, missing birthdays, school activities, family celebrations and important childhood moments.
Although financial support can help provide a better life, the emotional impact of prolonged separation can be difficult for both parents and children.
The circumstances surrounding the boy's reported collapse, including whether he needed medical attention, have not been independently confirmed.
Nevertheless, the reunion has reminded many people of the importance of family, parental presence and the emotional bond between mothers and their children.
Four years without seeing his mother, and suddenly she appeared right before his eyes. Imagine the emotions running through that little boy's heart.
What do you think about parents leaving their young children behind for several years to work abroad in search of a better future? Is the sacrifice worth it?

stories.h: Rivers politics: Fubara backs Wike's cross-party Rainbow Coalition and its 2027 candidates

body: Governor Siminalayi Fubara has publicly pledged support for President Tinubu, Nyesom Wike and the Rainbow Coalition's 2027 candidates in Rivers State. The seven-party alliance unveiled Kingsley Chinda and Major Jack, both of the APC, as its governorship and deputy governorship choices. The rest of its slate combines APC and PDP candidates.
## Why it is trending

"Rainbow Coalition" entered Nigeria's trending topics on X. The unveiling confirms that Fubara and Wike are now openly campaigning within the same political bloc after their long-running disagreement.
## What has changed
The reconciliation has moved from meetings and public statements to a jointly supported electoral slate. The coalition adopted:
Kingsley Chinda and Major Jack for governor and deputy governor.
Two APC and one PDP senatorial candidates.
Ten APC and three PDP House of Representatives candidates.
Twenty-one APC and eleven PDP State Assembly candidates.
## Still uncertain

A court challenge to Chinda's eligibility remains unresolved, with a hearing reportedly scheduled for 4 November 2026. The September Supreme Court decision at the centre of the dispute did not specifically disqualify Chinda, and rival groups disagree over what it means. The coalition's endorsement therefore does not settle the pending legal question.

stories.h: "I have lost everything I worked for, I am starting afresh" – Blessing CEO breaks down in tears as she recounts losing her son and her time in custody
stories.p: Relationship therapist Blessing CEO has broken down in tears while talking about losing her son and her time in detention, saying she has lost almost everything she built and must start again. She also said she is ready to look at her past mistakes and take a different path in life.
body: Controversial Nigerian relationship therapist and social media personality Blessing CEO has sparked emotional reactions after breaking down in tears while recounting some of the most painful experiences of her life, including the loss of her son and her time in custody.

In an emotional account, Blessing opened up about the personal struggles she has endured, revealing that her experiences have forced her to reflect deeply on her life, decisions and the direction she wants to take going forward.
According to her, she has lost virtually everything she spent years working to build and is now faced with the difficult task of starting all over again.
One of the most touching moments came when she spoke about losing her son, an experience that appeared to leave her overwhelmed with grief.
She also reflected on her time in detention and how it affected her emotionally and personally.
However, what caught the attention of many was her willingness to examine her past actions and acknowledge that there may be areas where she got things wrong.
Blessing expressed her readiness to identify her mistakes, make necessary corrections and take a different path in life.

For someone who has built a public image around controversial opinions, outspoken statements and heated social media exchanges, her emotional reflections have introduced another side of her personality to the public.
She now appears determined to rebuild her life, even if it means starting from nothing.
Her story raises important questions about personal growth, forgiveness and second chances. Can someone who has made mistakes in the past genuinely change and rebuild their life?

Whatever opinions people may have about Blessing CEO, watching someone speak about losing a child, being locked up and watching years of hard work disappear is a reminder that public figures also face painful personal struggles.

stories.h: BREAKING: Police arrest Umar Ibrahim Gandi over viral video calling for AK-47s to attack worshippers in Enugu and Jos
stories.p: Zamfara police have arrested Umar Ibrahim Gandi, 22, from Maradun LGA, over a viral video in which he is heard calling for rifles to kill Christians at Sunday worship in Enugu and Jos. Police say he faces allegations of incitement to violence, disturbance of public peace and criminal intimidation, and will be charged in court. JIBWIS has disassociated itself from his conduct.
body: The Zamfara State Police Command has arrested Umar Ibrahim Gandi, the man seen in a viral video calling for AK-47 rifles to carry out attacks against Christians in Enugu State and Jos, Plateau State.

Police identified the suspect as a 22-year-old native of Maradun Local Government Area of Zamfara State. They say the video was recorded on Friday, October 23, 2026, and that he faces allegations of incitement to violence, disturbance of public peace and criminal intimidation. The Commissioner of Police said an investigation is under way and that the suspect will be charged before a court.

In the video, the suspect, wearing the uniform of the JIBWIS (Izala) first-aid group, is heard chanting for rifles to kill people he calls "infidels" during Sunday worship. According to the police, JIBWIS has disassociated itself from his alleged conduct.

His statements raised serious concerns about religious extremism, hate speech and threats to innocent lives, and the video attracted widespread condemnation, with many Nigerians calling on the DSS and the police to identify and arrest him.
Particularly troubling was the presence of young children during the recording, raising questions about the exposure of minors to violent extremist messages.
Nigerians will now expect a thorough investigation and appropriate legal action based on the evidence. Like any suspect, he is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.

Nigeria cannot afford to treat public threats of violence against religious communities as ordinary social media content. Nobody should be threatened with death simply because of where they come from or how they worship God.

body: Taylor Jasmine, the girlfriend of popular Nigerian comedian and content creator Carter Efe, has stirred reactions on social media after expressing her sadness over her planned return to the United States.
Taylor, who has been spending time in Nigeria, appears to have developed a strong attachment to the country, making the thought of leaving particularly difficult for her.

In emotional posts on X, she wrote that she was up crying at 7:40 am because she was going back to her home in the US the next day. "I don't wanna leave Nigeria I swear. I'll be back soon," she wrote, adding in another post: "I don't wanna go back home. The fact I'm leaving tomorrow. I'm crying. I had some fun out here, man."
Her words have attracted attention online, with many Nigerians reacting to her apparent love for the country and the experiences she has enjoyed during her stay.

For someone who has experienced life in both America and Nigeria, her reluctance to leave has also sparked conversations about the things that make Nigeria special despite its numerous economic and social challenges.

Nigeria may be facing difficulties, but its vibrant entertainment industry, rich culture, lively social atmosphere and welcoming communities continue to attract visitors from different parts of the world.
Her relationship with Carter Efe has also placed her in the spotlight, with social media users following their activities and interactions.
While she has expressed her reluctance to leave, it remains unclear whether she intends to extend her stay or proceed with her planned journey to America.

The development has once again highlighted how Nigeria continues to leave lasting impressions on visitors, particularly those who develop personal relationships and meaningful connections during their stay.

stories.h: Concern grows over Nollywood actor Jerry Williams as producer Izutech calls out Actors Guild of Nigeria over alleged neglect

Izutech says he is willing to arrange a rehabilitation programme of up to two years and has appealed for support. His claims have not been independently verified.
body: Fresh concerns have emerged over the welfare of popular Nollywood actor Jerry Williams after filmmaker and producer Izutech publicly questioned the Actors Guild of Nigeria (AGN) over its alleged failure to provide sustained support for the troubled actor.
According to Izutech, the Actors Guild of Nigeria had previously promised to take responsibility for Jerry Williams' situation, but he is now questioning what became of that commitment.
The producer alleged that the once-popular Nollywood star is facing serious personal challenges, including suspected substance-related problems and concerns about his mental health.
Izutech further claimed that Jerry Williams has allegedly been sending private messages to people on Instagram, appealing for financial assistance to buy food and meet his basic needs.
The claims have raised concerns about the actor's welfare, particularly among those who remember his performances in several Nollywood productions.
Expressing his disappointment, Izutech questioned why an actor who contributed to Nigeria's entertainment industry should allegedly be left struggling without adequate support.
He also disclosed his willingness to intervene again by arranging a rehabilitation programme lasting up to two years, which he believes could help the actor recover and rebuild his life.
However, the producer admitted that such an intervention would require considerable financial resources and appealed for support from colleagues, industry stakeholders and well-meaning Nigerians.

The development has once again brought attention to the welfare of entertainers in Nollywood, especially actors facing health challenges, financial difficulties or personal crises after years in the spotlight.
It also raises questions about the responsibility of professional associations to support members experiencing serious difficulties.

While Izutech's allegations have attracted concern, the actor's current medical condition and the extent of any assistance provided by the Actors Guild of Nigeria have not been independently verified.
The bigger question remains: what support systems are available to Nollywood actors when they can no longer cope with life's challenges?
For many fans, the hope is that Jerry Williams receives appropriate professional care, genuine support and an opportunity to regain his health and stability.
Should the Actors Guild of Nigeria establish a dedicated welfare and rehabilitation fund to support actors facing serious personal and health challenges?
